## Current Projects

::: {.project-body}
### 📇 Mini-Intern: An intern for all your mini needs

::: {.project-links}
[View on GitHub](https://github.com/Thomas-Nguyen12/Mini-Intern)
:::
A project to create an open-source language model that is designed to follow instructions and be incorporated into agents.

Current models have usage limits and paid tiers that decrease accessibility and make innovation difficult. This project aims to rectify these issues by providing a platform where users can innovate and thrive without the barrier of a subscription.


:::
:::







::: {.project-card}
![](images/job_apply.png)


::: {.project-body}
### 📇 Job board Analysis

::: {.project-links}
[View on GitHub](https://github.com/Thomas-Nguyen12/apply_for_jobs)
:::

With sudden changes into the job market in the advent of A.I., it becomes increasingly important to adapt. This project aims to leverage new LLMs and agentic A.I. technologies to overcome the market.

This project is split into two parts:

1. Analysis of Job listings and trends
2. Automatic tailoring of CVs and cover letters for different jobs.

Prototypes will be written in Python, and production code (can) be written in Rust - for performance.

:::
:::
